title: Learning & Development Specialist
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW
Founded in 2000. SKG Properties specialises in the development, leasing and management of commercial and industrial real estate.
Joining us means seizing an opportunity to work in a dynamic, industry leading property company in South Africa, where ethic, customer service and teamwork are the foundation of our success.
ROLE OVERVIEW
To design, develop, and deliver learning programs in collaboration with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) while supporting change adoption in a fast-paced project environment. Initially, the role will focus on generalist responsibilitieslight-touch facilitation, basic change support, and LMS managementwith the expectation to evolve into a versatile L&D professional capable of handling advanced instructional design, digital learning, and structured change management.
Key Responsibilities
1. Learning Design & Development

• Conduct basic training needs analysis aligned with project and business priorities.

• Collaborate with SMEs to co-create learning content (classroom, virtual, and e-learning).

• Develop training materials and quick reference guides using tools such as Articulate, Scribe, Canva, and Bob Learn.

2. Facilitation & Delivery

• Support SMEs during initial training sessions, ensuring smooth delivery and learner engagement.

• Transition ownership of training delivery after the first tranche, leading refresher sessions and ongoing capability-building workshops.

• Deliver interactive sessions using blended learning approaches under tight timelines.

3. Change Enablement (Light-Touch)

• Act as a change support resource, reinforcing key messages and adoption strategies.

• Assist in basic communication and engagement activities to support system rollouts.

• Apply foundational change principles (e.g., awareness, reinforcement) without full-scale Prosci-level execution.

4. LMS Administration

• Manage the Learning Management System (LMS) for course uploads, user tracking, and reporting.

• Ensure accurate learner progress data and compliance reporting.

5. Continuous Improvement

• Gather learner feedback and update content for relevance and impact.

• Support the evolution of L&D practices toward digital learning and advanced change management.

Key Competencies

• Strong instructional design, facilitation skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to adapt quickly in high-pressure, project-driven environments.

• Basic understanding of change management principles.

• Proficiency in LMS administration and digital learning tools (Articulate, Scribe, Canva, Bob Learn).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

Qualifications & Experience

• Minimum: National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Human Resource Management, Education, Training & Development, or a related field.

• Preferred: Bachelors Degree (NQF Level 7) in HR, Industrial Psychology, or Education.

• Accredited Facilitator certification (ETDP SETA).

• Prosci Change Management Certification or similar (advantageous for future growth).

• 4 years experience in L&D, including design and delivery of training programs.

• Exposure to project management environments and digital learning tools.

Performance Indicators

• Timely delivery of training aligned with project milestones.

• Positive learner and stakeholder feedback.

• Effective LMS management and reporting.

• Demonstrated growth toward advanced L&D and change capabilities.

description:
your mission
The Role
You are the top of the funnel. Your job is to get the founder into 8-12 qualified conversations per month with supply chain and procurement leaders at target manufacturers.

These are two types of meetings:

• Product meetings - structured conversations with supply chain operators to validate features, get input on roadmap, and build relationships that convert into pipeline over time

• Sales meetings - qualified conversations with decision-makers at ICP accounts who understand what Epoch does and want to see it.

You own everything up to the meeting. The founder closes.

What Early-Stage Outbound Looks Like
This is not a volume game. You will not blast 500 emails and wait for replies. At an unknown brand, every touchpoint needs to earn attention

How to apply

• A short note on why this role fits you

• One real example of how you got a meeting at a company where nobody knew your brand - name the company, the person, the angle you used, and how many touches it took

• Your LinkedIn profile

We will know if you wrote this with LLMs. We screen every application for AI-generated content. Be specific, be detailed, be you. your profile

What You'll Actually Do

• Research target accounts - understand their supply chain, recent news, pain points, org structure

• Identify the right buyer (VP Supply Chain, Head of Procurement, COO, Plant Director)

• Write hyper-personalized outbound that earns a reply from someone who's never heard of us

• Build and run multi-touch sequences across email, LinkedIn, and warm intro paths

• Mine existing networks

• Frame meetings as value exchanges, not sales pitches

• Manage HubSpot pipeline, track outreach, report on conversion at every step

• Coordinate event follow-ups, podcast/webinar appearances, and content seeding that generates inbound

• Work directly with the founder daily

You're a Fit If

• You've done outbound at a B2B startup where nobody knew the brand - and got meetings anyway

• You can research a company and write a message that makes a VP stop scrolling

• You're comfortable working in manufacturing / supply chain / industrial context (or learn fast)

• You think in angles, not templates

• You write well in English. German is a strong plus.

• You're relentless on follow-up without being annoying

• You've used Apollo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot - but you know tools don't replace thinking

• You're an executor, not a strategist. You do the work, not the deck about the work.

title: LinkedIn Exec Content Writer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a LinkedIn executive content writer to run our executive content program for two brands: Darkroom, our growth marketing agency, and Shadow, our AI commerce platform. Ad Age recently described us as "if Omnicom was rebuilt on AI." Our buyers, founders and operators, spend their professional attention on LinkedIn, and our executives reach more of them than any company page.

You make our executives sound like themselves, consistently, every week. You interview them, write for them, plan what each of them posts, and edit until it reads like a person, not a brand. Team members who want to post get your help too.

This is a remote role, hiring in Brazil, Portugal or Spain only, working with a team in the EST Time Zone, and all business is conducted 100% in English.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- The Executive Content Program: Run it day to day across our executive team, so every account has a clear voice, a plan and a steady rhythm.

- Voice Interviews: Recorded interviews with executives that become posts close to their own words.

- Context Files: A living file for every executive: voice, expertise, stories and the lines they won't cross, built from calls, talks and interviews.

- Ghostwriting: Ideas, drafts, edits and approvals for executive posts, end to end.

- The Executive Calendar: One calendar across all executive accounts. You decide who posts for each launch and keep topics from colliding.

- Launch Days: Coordinate executive posts around launches, webinars and events so the accounts reinforce each other.

- Formats: Text posts, carousels, short video clip scripts, and posts repurposed from talks and appearances.

- Editing: Every draft gets a human edit. Marketing speak comes out; the person's voice stays in.

- Reading What Works: Track which topics, formats and voices reach our buyers, and feed it back into the calendar.

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

- You have ghostwritten for founders or executives on LinkedIn, and the posts sounded like them. Send links.

- You understand B2B buyers making considered decisions.

- You know commerce and growth well enough to write about DTC, performance marketing, retention and AI tooling without a briefing.

- You can interview a busy executive for 20 minutes and leave with a week of posts, in several distinct voices.

- You are a sharp editor who cuts marketing speak and keeps a person's voice.

- You know LinkedIn formats and distribution: hooks, carousels, native video, comments.

- You already work with Claude, ChatGPT, or similar daily for research and ideas, and you know where AI stops and editing starts.

HARD DISQUALIFIERS

- No ghostwriting samples for executives or founders.

- Copy that reads like marketing, not like a person.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace-we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Production Quality Control Specialist
description:
Quality Control Specialist

Department: Production

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours/week)

About Drips

Drips engages people in two-way, compliance-governed SMS conversations - the kind that get responses, drive action, and close the gaps traditional outreach leaves open.

In practice, that means Drips helps organizations connect with their customers through large-scale, automated text and phone campaigns. Our proprietary platform lets clients design conversations, schedule outreach, and route responses so the right messages reach the right people at the right time.

The Quality Control Specialist role is what confirms those campaigns actually work the way they're supposed to before real customers ever see them.

Role Overview

As a Quality Control Specialist, you test our product. You take completed builds and verify, end to end, that they behave the way they're supposed to in real-world conditions - not just that the settings look right on screen, but that messages send on time, calls route correctly, and the experience holds up once it's live. You'll manage a steady queue of cases moving through QC, prioritizing your work so nothing sits and nothing slips through untested.

You will:

• Run functional and regression tests on completed builds to confirm they perform as intended - checking timing, routing, message content, and call behavior against real-world scenarios.

• Own a queue of QC cases from intake through completion, picking up work once Build has finished configuring it and seeing each case all the way through to a clean, documented close.

• Identify, document, and communicate defects clearly, so the right fix gets made by the right team without back-and-forth guessing.

This role calls for a bit more technical depth than some other Production roles - you'll want a real grasp of how the system behaves and why, not just how to click through it.

What You’ll Do

Execute Functional & Regression Testing

• Test completed campaign builds end to end: message timing and sequencing, call routing, audio playback, and digit-press behavior.

• Verify that changes behave correctly across real-world conditions - different carriers, devices, and time zones - not just in an idealized test case.

• Run regression tests to confirm that a fix or change hasn't broken something else in the process.

Own a Queue of QC Cases

• Manage a steady flow of cases moving into QC once Build has finished its work, prioritizing based on urgency, launch dates, and complexity.

• See each case through from intake to a fully tested, documented close - you're the last check before something goes live.

• Keep the queue moving without letting cases stall or pile up.

Partner with Build and Product Engineering

• Coordinate directly with the Build team when a case needs rework, giving them clear, specific detail on what didn't pass and why.

• Work with Product Engineering when an issue traces back to the underlying system rather than a specific campaign configuration.

• Translate technical findings into plain language so both technical and non-technical partners understand what was found and what it means.

Document and Report on Quality

• Document test cases and results in a test management platform, so there's a clear record of what was tested and how it performed.

• Maintain a dashboard of defect results to track trends and flag recurring problem areas.

• Deliver regular reports to leadership summarizing findings, risks, and improvement opportunities.

Examples of Day-to-Day Tasks

On a typical day, you might:

• Pick up a case handed off from Build after a new campaign has been configured and run it through end-to-end functional testing - confirming routing, timing, audio, and message delivery all behave as intended before closing it out.

• Investigate a reported defect, reproduce it, document the steps clearly in our test management platform, and route it to Build or Product Engineering depending on where the

• Develop software that enables engineers to reproduce and investigate difficult hardware failures.

• Contribute reusable libraries and utilities that improve engineering productivity across multiple validation teams.

Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time - protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do
As an Audio Annotation Analyst on the Research team, you will review and annotate audio recordings, video content, and associated interaction data to support the development, evaluation, and improvement of Pindrop 's fraud detection, authentication, and deepfake detection technologies. Your assignments will span audio and video annotation projects based on evolving Research priorities and team needs.
Your primary responsibility will be to produce accurate, consistent, and high-quality annotations across a variety of Research projects. You will also support targeted investigations by reviewing interactions, identifying anomalies, and documenting observations that help Research Scientists better understand model performance and real-world customer interactions.
You will…

• Review and annotate audio recordings, video content, and associated interaction data, assigning accurate labels based on project-specific guidelines and classification criteria.

• Apply established classification criteria to identify potential fraud indicators, authentication outcomes, characteristics of human-generated versus synthetic content, and other attributes relevant to Research projects, including intent recognition when applicable.

• Apply annotation guidelines consistently across large datasets, review existing labels for discrepancies, and help maintain high-quality datasets for model development and evaluation.

• Flag interactions that are difficult to classify or fall outside established guidelines, document observations, and collaborate with Research Scientists to resolve edge cases.

• Support Research investigations by reviewing audio and video interactions to identify potential issues such as background noise, audio quality degradation, IVR process gaps, or unexpected model behavior.

• Conduct targeted interaction and metadata reviews to support customer inquiries, model evaluations, and evolving Research priorities.

• Maintain accurate annotation records and summarize findings, recurring patterns, and classification inconsistencies to support Research analysis and model improvements.

• Handle sensitive audio, video, and interaction data responsibly, following established privacy, security, and confidentiality guidelines.

Who you are
You are…

• Exceptionally attentive to detail, with strong listening and observational skills to identify subtle differences in audio, video, and interactions.

• Comfortable with focused, repetitive review work and able to maintain accuracy and consistency across large volumes of data.

• Able to follow detailed guidelines while exercising sound judgment when encountering ambiguous or unfamiliar situations.

• Organized, self-driven, and able to document classification decision

Transaction Monitoring

Experience

title: Head of Sales Excellence & Methodology
locationText: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's sales organization is growing quickly across segments, industries, and geographies, and how we sell has to mature as fast as the team does. We are looking for a Head of Sales Excellence & Methodology to own the substance of sales enablement at Anthropic: the sales methodology itself, the standard for what excellent selling looks like here, and the change management that makes it stick in the field.

You will define a common way of selling that holds up across very different customers, from startups to the largest global enterprises, and then lead the organization through adopting it. That means earning sponsorship from senior sales leadership, equipping frontline managers to coach to the methodology instead of only inspecting for it, and building alongside sellers so the result reflects how deals are really won.

This is a leadership role for someone who has taken a sales organization through real transformation and can show that it changed behavior and results. You will set direction, [build and lead a team], and stay close enough to the field to know when something is not working.

Key responsibilities:

•
Define, document, and evolve Anthropic's sales methodology and process standards, including discovery, qualification, deal strategy, and deal review, so that sellers in every segment and region share a common language

•
Design and run the rollout and reinforcement of methodology changes across the sales organization, securing executive sponsorship and making clear what is expected of each level of sales leadership

•
Equip frontline managers to coach to the methodology in pipeline reviews, deal reviews, and forecasting, so that it becomes part of the operating rhythm

•
Sequence and deliver complex, multi-audience programs across geographies, segments, industries, and roles that scale globally while adapting where local or segment differences matter

•
Develop content, frameworks, and standards together with sellers and sales leaders, testing them on live deals before scaling

•
Define the leading and lagging indicators that show whether the methodology is changing seller behavior and outcomes, and act on what the data shows

•
Partner with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Product, Marketing, and the wider Sales Enablement team so the methodology is reflected in systems, messaging, and day-to-day workflows

•
Apply Claude and internal tooling to personalize coaching and reinforcement, so that quality does not depend on headcount

Minimum qualifications:

•
Practitioner-level expertise in sales methodology and sales process design, including discovery, qualification, deal strategy, deal review, and forecasting

•
Have led a methodology or sales process change across a sales organization, and can show how seller behavior and results changed as a result

•
Have run enablement or sales excellence programs spanning multiple geographies, segments, industries, or roles

•
Have worked directly with senior sales leaders and frontline managers to secure sponsorship for change, including holding a position constructively when they disagreed

•
Have built programs with sellers and sales leaders, testing them on live deals, instead of handing down finished programs

•
Have defined and tracked adoption and impact measures that go beyond completion and satisfaction scores

•
Communicate clearly, in writing and in conversation, with executive audiences

Preferred qualifications:

•
Experience building and leading a team of senior enablement or sales excellence professionals

•
A clear, experience-based view of where common sales methodologies break down in practice

title: Senior Payroll Specialist
description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

ABOUT YOU

LiveKit's team is growing fast, in the US and around the world, and Finance is taking over payroll. You'll be the person who makes it run: every employee, every state, every country, every filing.
Most senior payroll roles hand you a well-oiled machine and ask you not to break it. This one asks you to build it. You'll own US and international payroll, set up the calendar and controls, assist with month end close, and be the internal expert on anything that touches a paycheck.

You'll thrive as the Senior Payroll Specialist if you:

- are obsessive about tying out numbers to the penny

- are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

- work hard and can build and ship fast

- are focused on polish, detail and quality

- are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd implement LiveKit, and potentially tinkering with it 😊

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Senior Payroll Specialist at LiveKit, you will:

- Run US and international payroll end to end, from collecting inputs to final reconciliation

- Own all associated payroll tax filings, domestic and international, and keep us compliant and on time

- Manage our PEO and EOR relationships, and know where their responsibility ends and yours begins

- Reconcile payroll to the general ledger each cycle and support month-end close

- Build and maintain our payroll calendar, processes, and documentation as payroll moves into Finance

- Partner with People/Talent and accounting on new hires, changes, terminations, and month-end reconciliation

- Support equity administration in Carta and equity reporting for the board

- Be the go-to contact for payroll questions internally and for auditor requests externally

WHO YOU ARE

- Hands-on experience running both US and international payroll, including Canada and/or the EU

- Experience managing payroll tax filings directly, not just handing them off to a provider

- Experience with multi-state US payroll for a remote, distributed team

- Strong experience working within PEO and/or EOR structures

- Familiarity with startup-focused platforms such as Rippling, Deel, Remote, or similar

- Comfort working independently as the subject-matter expert, juggling many moving pieces and flagging tax, legal, and compliance risk before it becomes a problem

NICE TO HAVE

- CPP, FPC, or a similar payroll certification

- Experience moving payroll in-house, switching providers, or migrating an HRIS

- Experience with equity administration in Carta

- Experience at a fast-growing company with a distributed, international team

- You've personally caught a payroll error before anyone else did, and you still think about it fondly

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

- An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

- Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Health, dental, and vision benefits

- Flexible vacation policy

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

About Us
At Verisian , we build deep tech and AI solutions that enable groundbreaking medical therapies to enter the market faster and safely. New medicines and devices are judged using all available evidence in the proper context and backed by automated analyses that validate and make data and results transparent to companies and regulators alike. Regulators will make the right decisions on novel therapies faster and with greater confidence, protecting patients from harm and making breakthrough treatments available as soon as is possible and safe.
In times of increasing trial numbers and complexity, we are building technical innovation to remove crucial bottlenecks for pharmaceutical and medical device companies, as well as public health authorities, directly affecting clinical trial planning, analyses, validation, submission, and market approval.
By joining us, you will commit yourself to building software and AI tools that directly contribute to increasing the rate at which medical innovation improves human health and wellbeing.
Disclaimer:
We welcome candidates of diverse experience levels, and meeting every requirement is not mandatory. Research indicates that underrepresented groups tend to apply only if they meet all qualifications. If you're enthusiastic about the role, please apply and let our recruiters evaluate your application.
Culture
At Verisian , our mission is to build the future infrastructure of medical innovation. To help us succeed, we're creating a unique employee culture. We always put the mission first. The Verisian Platform brings value to a set of highly regulated processes crucial for medical progress and innovation. Your work will support the Planner, Builder, Explorer, Validator, Submitter, and related supporting modules. These core modules of the platform target the planning, exploration/onboarding, building, validation, submission, and review of clinical trials and their results. They enable data managers, statistical programmers, statisticians, medical writers, and regulators to deliver their work faster, at higher quality, lower cost, and in greater confidence.
Our pipelines analyze clinical trial documentation, code, logs, data, and results to build a knowledge graph through code traceability. We harness the resulting dataset, column-level and logic lineage to turn clinical trials into Information Infrastructure that can be used by experts and consumed by AI to revolutionize how therapies are evaluated and enter the market. We capture complex processes in fully- and semi-automated workflows that place experts in control and AI automation at their fingertips. We build visualizations to provide our customers with a maximum of insight as fast as possible.
Our application stack is based on Next.js and deployed via Docker/Kubernetes in the cloud. The data analysis pipelines run in Argo Workflows. We analyze code based on Antlr4 and Java. AI agents are developed in Python. Git is where our code lives, and Github Actions is how it gets out into the world.

title: FCM - VIP After-Hours Emergency Corporate Travel Consultant - Remote, USA
description:
VIP After-Hours Emergency Corporate Travel Consultant

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.
To learn more about FCM please click HERE
About the Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced VIP Corporate Travel Consultant to join our Emergency Customer Care (ECC) team, delivering white-glove, personalized service to C-Suite executives and high-profile clients during after-hours, overnight, weekend, and holiday periods. This role is uniquely designed for a seasoned travel professional who thrives in high-pressure situations and understands that for our VIP clientele, exceptional service never sleeps.

As a VIP Emergency Customer Care Consultant, you will manage urgent and complex domestic and international travel requests, including air, hotel, car, and ground transportation, via Sabre GDS, while maintaining the highest standard of professionalism, discretion, and client satisfaction. You will serve as a trusted advisor and first point of contact when our most valued clients need assistance the most.

Before you begin your role, you will complete a four-week paid training program designed to boost your industry knowledge, train you on contract airfares, and sharpen your Sabre skills, ensuring you are fully equipped to deliver the VIP experience our clients expect around the clock.

**Please note that this is a remote after-hours position that requires working overnights, weekends, and holidays**

This position requires flexible hours and shift availability as determined by business need and client call volume.

Key Responsibilities

• Deliver exceptional, white-glove service to C-Suite travelers and their administrative staff during after-hours and emergency situations, ensuring all interactions are handled with the utmost professionalism and discretion.

• Provide consultative support throughout the booking process, crafting bespoke travel itineraries tailored to the specific needs and elevated expectations of VIP and executive-level clients.

• Coordinate urgent air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for complex domestic and international travel, often within time-sensitive and high-pressure timelines.

• Expertly manage rerouting, exchanges, and itinerary changes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans and a seamless experience for the client from start to finish.

• Proactively gather, retain, and apply client travel preferences and profiles to deliver a consistently personalized and anticipatory level of service.

• Keep VIP clients informed of all necessary travel documents, visa requirements, and health requirements for international destinations, providing guidance with confidence and accuracy.

• Proficiently handle ticketing, Phase IVs, and complex exchanges and changes involving both domestic and international fares.

• Execute all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, PNR documentation and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and quality control, maintaining the highest degree of accuracy throughout.

• Stay fully informed of airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements, applying this knowledge accurately and efficiently to all travel arrangements.

• Demonstrate creative thinking and decisive problem-solving skills to provide optimal travel solutions in fast-paced, high-stakes situations.

• Maintain ongoing communication with team members, Travel Managers, and Team Leaders through provided channels to ensure a united, consistent, and professional approach to VIP account management.

• Complete all reservations

title: Privacy Program Manager
description:
Privacy Program Manager

Help shape how privacy is governed across our digital environment.
Join the Enterprise Privacy Office as a Privacy Program Manager and help turn enterprise privacy goals into practical action. Reporting to the Chief Privacy Counsel and working under the direction of cross-functional leadership, you will manage the program, governance and platforms used to monitor, assess, and govern online privacy technologies across our websites and mobile applications.
You will bring teams together, advance strategic initiatives, and turn platform capabilities and privacy requirements into clear decisions, controls, and measurable results. This role is a strong fit for someone who can advance governance, communicate clearly, and build trusted partnerships across privacy, legal, information security, engineering, product, marketing, procurement, and business teams.
What you’ll do:

• Turn the goals and priorities set by privacy leadership into clear roadmaps, milestones, resources, budgets, and measures of success.

• Manage the governance and day-to-day operation of online privacy technology platforms, including onboarding, configuration, access, integrations, releases, and vendor support.

• Maintain clear decision rights, intake and priority processes, committee forums, issue resolution, exceptions, and escalation paths.

• Turn platform findings into assigned actions, remove barriers, confirm updates, and manage potential risks.

• Keep a current view of covered websites and mobile applications, owners, platform status, open issues, and dependencies.

• Use technical evidence, privacy requirements, business context, and consumer impact to support practical decisions and controls.

• Support and participate in privacy impact assessments for new and changing online privacy technologies.

• Provide clear reporting on program progress, platform coverage, findings, aging, exceptions, control performance, and resource needs.

• Manage platform providers, product roadmaps, support, licensing, contracts, budgets, deliverables, and performance.

• Improve the program by simplifying work, strengthening data quality, automating repeatable tasks, and embedding privacy into digital initiatives.

• Support incident response by preserving platform evidence and coordinating timely assessment with privacy, legal, security, and application teams.

What you need to do the job:

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent relevant work experience.

• At least 7+ of experience leading complex privacy, technology, security, compliance, digital, or enterprise programs.

• Experience managing enterprise platforms through implementation, governance, integration, and ongoing operations.

• Strong program management and governance skills, including roadmaps, risks, budgets, governance, vendor management, and executive reporting.

• Ability to understand and explain websites, mobile applications, cookies, pixels, tags, scripts, APIs, consent tools, and related data flows.

• Ability to work across technical, legal, and business teams, create clarity from ambiguity, and move work from decision to completion.

• Strong judgment, analytical thinking, facilitation, writing, and presentation skill

description:

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

This role will be responsible for managing and delivering the full SEO scope across technical SEO, content, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and Google Business Profile, while acting as a key day-to-day contact for the client.

• Lead the SEO strategy and day-to-day delivery.

• Act as the main point of contact for the client on SEO matters, ensuring smooth communication, alignment, and delivery against agreed objectives.

• Oversee technical SEO audits and implementation planning, covering crawlability, indexation, site performance, mobile usability, structured data, and internal linking.

• Good understanding of GEO / AI search optimization and how brands can improve visibility across LLMs and generative search platforms.

• US-based, with a Bachelor’s degree

• Someone who already uses AI in daily life

• Detail-oriented, great at following instructions and documenting each step

• Clear written communication

• Generalists welcome, domain experts preferred

• No coding or AI background needed

You will translate customer and market insights into a compelling, multi-year vision, align senior stakeholders and cross functional teams around strategic priorities, and build capabilities and operating models needed to deliver measurable merchant and business impacts.

Beyond leading individual product teams, you will connect strategy across multiple product areas, identify portfolio-wide opportunities and challenges, and make strategic trade-offs that maximize customer and business value.

You will bring demonstrated experience setting strategy at a scale materially larger than a single product or team, having shaped direction across a broad portfolio, platform, business unit, or company-level domain.

What you’ll be doing:

- Set product strategy and vision

- Define and communicate a multi-year product strategy across a substantial portfolio or business area, aligned with broader company priorities.

- Guide investment and prioritization decisions using customer insights, data, market dynamics, competitive intelligence, and business outcomes.

- Partner with cross-functional leaders to identify opportunities for growth, revenue, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.

- Lead portfolio execution and outcomes

- Own strategy, execution, and measurable outcomes across multiple product areas, platforms, or a substantial portfolio.

- Influence and communicate

- Communicate complex customer, market, and business challenges clearly to drive decisions and action.

- Strengthen customer and retailer empathy across the organization while balancing speed, quality, and long-term value.

What you need to bring:

- Significant product management experience within software or technology companies, with a proven track record of delivering measurable business and customer impact across multiple product areas.

- Demonstrated experience setting and executing strategy at a portfolio, platform, business unit, or organizational level, beyond the scope of a single product or team.

- Strong strategic and portfolio management capabilities, with the ability to prioritize investments, navigate trade-offs, and make high-impact decisions across multiple planning horizons.

title: Senior Applied AI Lead, Talent
description:
At Netflix , our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
Our Talent AI Team:
We are at a very exciting stage of evolution at Netflix . As we experience growth in our employee population, lines of business, geographical footprint, and workforce heterogeneity, it is imperative that the Talent function evolves accordingly to shape and support this progress. One of the most critical parts of this evolution is the foundation upon which we can scale personalized and inclusive experiences for the workforce.
Our Talent AI team is focused on helping to drive change at scale. The team is fundamentally helping to find ways to drive AI powered solutions in how we attract, develop, and retain the extraordinary people who power our business, while also helping to drive greater AI adoption and fluency across Talent. This team is critical in identifying, prototyping, and shipping AI-powered capabilities across the full Talent lifecycle. The team works closely with all functional areas across Talent - as well as Netflix 's central AI teams.
The Role:
We are looking for a Senior Applied AI Lead who can bridge the gap between Talent's biggest opportunities and what is possible with today's AI tools. This person can both envision high-impact solutions and build working prototypes that turn ideas into something stakeholders can actually touch and react to - before a single engineer is engaged.
This is not a traditional product manager role or an engineering role. It sits in the space between: someone with strong Talent domain expertise and genuine AI fluency who moves fast, exercises high judgment about what is worth building, and knows how to take a prototype all the way to a production partnership with engineering.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Partnering with Talent teams to identify the highest-value AI opportunities.

• Defining problem statements, scope solutions, and prioritizing ruthlessly - distinguishing genuinely high-leverage AI applications from novelty.

• Developing a deep understanding of Talent's data landscape, workflow pain points, and strategic priorities to inform where AI can create durable impact.

• Designing and building working AI prototypes - from scoping the problem to putting a functional demo in front of stakeholders for validation.

• Use LLM APIs, agent frameworks, AI-native platforms, and workflow automation tools to rapidly iterate without requiring dedicated engineering resources.

• Translating validated prototypes into tight product requirements and partnering with engineering to move from proof-of-concept to production.

• Acting as the domain and product authority for Talent AI features in technical design discussions - bridging the gap between what Talent needs and what engineering builds.

• Owning outcomes, not just outputs - staying engaged through deployment and adoption to ensure the solution actually delivers value.

• Evaluating AI tools, platforms, and vendors with rigor - building a clear point of view on what to adopt off-the-shelf, what to integrate, and what to build custom.

• Staying current on the rapidly evolving AI landscape and translating new capabilities into practical Talent opportunities faster than our peers.

• Building the playbooks, prompting guides, and workflow blueprints that help Talent teams get genuine leverage from AI tools - not just familiarity.

• Developing other Talent team members' AI fluency through hands-on sessions, shared examples, and clear frameworks for when and how to use AI.

• Ensuring every AI solution is designed with appropriate data privacy, security, and fairness considerations - partnering with Legal, Infosec, and oth

description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken https://kraken.tech/ powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏠 WHERE YOU'LL FIT IN:

Kraken’s technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 1,400 people globally, which includes server-side, client-side, and mobile engineers. We follow an agile way of working, where individual teams are given the freedom to choose the tools that are most appropriate for managing their work.

Kraken is a great place to learn, work with talented engineers and level-up your skills. Some of our coding conventions are open-source.

Engineer II roles (usually 4-8 years exp) are available remotely within Japan or hybrid from Tokyo.

 

OUR TECHNOLOGY

Our backend developers use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and GraphQL (Graphene). Our CircleCI CI/CD pipeline runs tens of thousands of tests, deploying into AWS EKS defined by Terraform over 100 times per day and observed with tools like Sentry and Datadog. This allows us to move fast and at scale, without compromising reliability. Teams work differently but the commitment to quality is the same.

Developers at Kraken are empowered to use cutting-edge AI tools and models. Any generated code is still owned by a human.

 

WHAT WE DO

Kraken Engineering has multiple disciplinary groups with their own management structures and teams working together to create a unified Kraken that can be deployed to any territory in the world to achieve clients’ goals.

At Kraken, you won't be boxed into one rigid path. Depending on your strengths and interests, you might find yourself modeling local energy markets, scaling a financial product across international territories, or driving the core comms engine behind all Kraken communications. Alternatively, you could be working directly with clients to enhance Kraken to solve their business needs or localise a particular market and help onboard their customers into the system. Whichever team you join, you’ll be solving complex problems with a group of genuinely great people.

 

🚀 WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

Eng II candidates should already be coding at a strong technical level similar to a senior engineer, but will still receive support for broader architectural complexity, cross-domain challenges and continued career growth.

We hire Engineers who have the skills and drive to keep growing. In this role, you will:

- Core Delivery: Solve complex domain modeling challenges in the energy sector, writing robust, fault-tolerant software primarily in Python, Django, GraphQL, Celery, and PostgreSQL.

- Code Quality & Testing: Write clean code alongside unit, integration, and functional tests covering happy path, boundary, and exceptional scenarios.

- Problem Solving & Debugging: Use structured methods to debug production issues, learn from failures, and build familiarity with a large, complex codebase.

- Documentation: Write clear, useful documentation for new and existing features to support your team and non-technical stakeholders.

- Collaboration: Share opinions respectfully, accept actionable feedback gracefully, and actively contribute to a supportive, growth-focused team culture.

For Eng II candidates, you will additionally:

- Feature Ownership & Observability: Confidently own and deliver medium-sized engineering problems, address system observability gaps, and manage technical escalations independently.

- Mentorship & Leadership: Mentor
